## The short version

A compact overview of what changed and what matters.

## What happened

The development, paper, model, dataset, or result in context.

## What they actually did

The data, methods, experiments, comparisons, and evidence behind the claim.

## Why it matters

The scientific consequence—not only the benchmark result.

## What I find interesting

The synthesis: what a climate researcher might update in their mental model.

## Limitations and open questions

Generalization, nonstationarity, physical consistency, uncertainty, interpretation, or missing comparisons.

## Where this fits in the field

Connections to previous approaches and what the work suggests about where the field is going.

## Papers and resources

A curated set of primary papers, technical reports, code, datasets, or useful commentary. Cite bibliography entries with `[@citationkey]` and add their records to `references.bib`.
